pages.title: The Tree of Life
pages.text: $(thing)The Tree of Life$()$(br2)Every living thing on one branching tree from a single root, four billion years deep. The five pieces of life, from the cell to the biosphere, make one endgame catalyst that never wears.

$(thing)Insight$(): 300$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Predator and Prey, Gene Circuits, Immune Memory, Abiogenesis.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Living Cell, 1 Grown Organ, 1 Stable Ecosystem.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A branching tree doubles its tips at each of g levels. Write how many tips T it ends with, from one root.
